changelog: Subtitle burn-in validates each redirect explicitly, rejects non-HTTP(S) and HTTPS-to-HTTP targets, and never forwards resolver credentials across an origin change
Subtitle burn-in rejects HTML/login pages and caps subtitle payloads at 2 MB before parsing, preventing unbounded renderer preparation work
Subtitle burn-in sanitizes and bounds generated MP4 filenames while limiting hostile cue text and overlapping caption frames before Media3 overlay rendering
